description: Call this when you need a working form to start from or a pattern to copy, such as multi-step forms, branching routes, conditions or translations; capabilities lists every option but shows no complete form. Without id, lists the bundled example definitions. With id, returns that definition. Adapt it, then check it with validate_definition.

id.description: Id of one example, such as "branching-account", taken from the list this tool returns without id. Omit to list the examples.

name: example_definitions
title: Example definitions
